About Warpfy

We are a fast-growing cross-border eCommerce brand, taking Indian products to the world (US, Australia, Canada). Our team includes ex-McKinsey, Amazon, Wayfair, and ex-founders, united by a mission to make Made in India global. At Warpfy, you’ll work in a high-speed, entrepreneurial environment where ownership and creativity matter more than titles.

What You’ll Do

Build simple but powerful tools and agents that automate workflows and business processes
Experiment with prompt engineering and AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) to convert concepts into working products
Develop lightweight backends and integrations with third-party platforms (Slack, Google Sheets, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, etc.)
Work closely with business and operations teams to turn automation ideas into live tools
Rapidly prototype, test, and improve solutions with feedback loops
Document processes and build re-usable code snippets for scaling future tools
What We’re Looking For

Fresh graduate or final-year student in CS/Engineering OR self-taught builder with projects to show
Comfortable coding in Python/JS (bonus if you’ve tinkered with Flask/FastAPI, Node, or similar)
Curiosity for AI/LLMs, APIs, and prompt engineering
Hacker mindset – you enjoy figuring things out, shipping fast, and improving along the way
Basic understanding of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
Strong problem-solving, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently
Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge AI + eCommerce automation projects
Exposure to global business operations (US, AU, CA markets)
Flat team, direct collaboration with founders
Freedom to experiment and ship real tools used by the business
Internship → Potential for full-time role
Stipend / Salary + perks

About Us

We are an innovative technology company building digital products and solutions in areas like e-commerce, AI, and streaming platforms. We’re looking for a passionate Software Tester Intern who is eager to learn and contribute to delivering high-quality software.

Responsibilities

Assist in reviewing and analyzing system requirements.
Execute manual test cases for web and mobile applications.
Document test results and report bugs clearly.
Work with developers and product teams to understand features and ensure quality.
Learn and apply testing best practices, including regression and usability testing.
Requirements

Basic understanding of software testing concepts and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
Familiarity with writing test cases and identifying bugs.
Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/diploma in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
Nice to Have (Optional)

Knowledge of bug tracking tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Exposure to automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Postman).
Basic understanding of SQL or API testing.
What You’ll Gain

Hands-on experience with real projects in a professional development environment.
Mentorship and guidance from experienced testers and developers.
Opportunity to learn both manual testing skills.
A potential pathway to a full-time role based on performance.

Pay: ₹7,000.00 - ₹10,000.00 per month

Bachelor's (Preferred)
Work Location: In person

About Warpfy

We are a fast-growing cross-border eCommerce brand, taking Indian products to the world (US, Australia, Canada). Our team includes ex-McKinsey, Amazon, Wayfair, and ex-founders, united by a mission to make Made in India global. At Warpfy, you’ll work in a high-speed, entrepreneurial environment where ownership and creativity matter more than titles.

What You’ll Do

Build simple but powerful tools and agents that automate workflows and business processes
Experiment with prompt engineering and AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) to convert concepts into working products
Develop lightweight backends and integrations with third-party platforms (Slack, Google Sheets, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, etc.)
Work closely with business and operations teams to turn automation ideas into live tools
Rapidly prototype, test, and improve solutions with feedback loops
Document processes and build re-usable code snippets for scaling future tools
What We’re Looking For

Fresh graduate or final-year student in CS/Engineering OR self-taught builder with projects to show
Comfortable coding in Python/JS (bonus if you’ve tinkered with Flask/FastAPI, Node, or similar)
Curiosity for AI/LLMs, APIs, and prompt engineering
Hacker mindset – you enjoy figuring things out, shipping fast, and improving along the way
Basic understanding of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
Strong problem-solving, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently
Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge AI + eCommerce automation projects
Exposure to global business operations (US, AU, CA markets)
Flat team, direct collaboration with founders
Freedom to experiment and ship real tools used by the business

Embark on a transformative journey as a Data Analyst at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
This role is within the Data Curation and Engagement team, which is responsible for the delivery and development of business, regulatory and Client reporting across Barclaycard Payments. The role will involve engaging with stakeholders from across the business, to carry out requirement analysis, data discovery and prototyping to assist in leveraging available data and in the development of reporting and analytical solutions to satisfy business use case needs and ensuring the continuity of reporting following source systems and platform changes. The roles holder will be required to drive best practice in data solutions, demonstrate strong data governance principles and be seeking to continually drive process improvements.
To be a successful Data Analyst you should have experience with:
Accountable to the Head of Data Curation and Engagement to provide support to the data delivery.
Engage with the required stakeholders to analyse requirements, undertake data discovery and prototype business rules to fastrack subsequent data solution delivery / automate data movement and processing.
Maintain documentation of data reporting controls and processes for compliance.
Empowered to optimise and improve data processes.
Application of advanced data analytical techniques to solve complex business problems. 
Designing and prototyping Solutions for data transformation and data cleansing to prepare data for analysis.
Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include
Experience of working with a range of stakeholders and building effective relationships across the business and geographies.
Strong knowledge of SAS, Databricks and SQL.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to articulate technical findings in business terms and demonstrate value to stakeholders.

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.

This role is within the Data Curation and Engagement team, which is responsible for the delivery and development of business, regulatory and Client reporting across Barclaycard Payments. The role will involve engaging with stakeholders from across the business, to carry out requirement analysis, data discovery and prototyping to assist in leveraging available data and in the development of reporting and analytical solutions to satisfy business use case needs and ensuring the continuity of reporting following source systems and platform changes. The roles holder will be required to drive best practice in data solutions, demonstrate strong data governance principles and be seeking to continually drive process improvements.
To be a successful Data Analyst you should have experience with:
Accountable to the Head of Data Curation and Engagement to provide support to the data delivery.
Engage with the required stakeholders to analyse requirements, undertake data discovery and prototype business rules to fastrack subsequent data solution delivery / automate data movement and processing.
Maintain documentation of data reporting controls and processes for compliance.
Empowered to optimise and improve data processes.
Application of advanced data analytical techniques to solve complex business problems. 
Designing and prototyping Solutions for data transformation and data cleansing to prepare data for analysis.
Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include
Experience of working with a range of stakeholders and building effective relationships across the business and geographies.
Strong knowledge of SAS, Databricks and SQL.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to articulate technical findings in business terms and demonstrate value to stakeholders.

Address: C 210 P, Phase 8B, Industrial Area, Sector 74, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160055

We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. Website UI/UX Designer and Developer with expertise in creating, customizing, and maintaining websites on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi. Website Optimization:
Ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, and performance, across all platforms.

Manage deployments and updates across WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi websites.

Front-End Expertise:
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
Experience with JavaScript frameworks or libraries like jQuery for dynamic features.
WordPress Development:
Advanced experience in WordPress theme and plugin development using PHP.
Extensive experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) for custom content management in WordPress.
Shopify Development:
Expertise in Shopify theme customization and building custom features using Liquid.
Familiarity with Shopify APIs for integrating third-party apps and services.
Kajabi Development:
Strong experience working with Kajabi for designing and customizing membership, course, and sales funnel pages.
Ability to use Liquid for advanced customizations in Kajabi to enhance functionality and design.
E-commerce Expertise:
Proficiency in setting up and customizing e-commerce stores on Shopify and WooCommerce.
Experience with Kajabi for building and optimizing online courses, memberships, and sales funnels.
API & REST API Integration:
Experience with API integration across platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Kajabi) for custom functionality.
Performance & SEO Optimization:
Proven track record of optimizing website speed, performance, and SEO best practices across platforms.

You will work across the technology stack—from backend logic and APIs to intuitive, high-performance frontends—ensuring seamless integration of intelligent agents into our products. This is a high-impact role for a driven engineer who thrives in fast-paced, innovation-led environments and is eager to work on next-generation AI systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.
Build APIs and backend services to support intelligent agent workflows and Edtech functionalities.
Collaborate with AI researchers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to deliver intuitive user experiences.
Implement real-time data visualization, reporting dashboards, and interactive interfaces.
Integrate third-party services, APIs, and AI/ML models into platform features.
Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment.
Document technical designs, architecture decisions, and development processes.
Stay updated with emerging tools, frameworks, and AI-powered development trends.
What We Are Looking For
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js (or similar frontend frameworks), and Node.js (or similar backend frameworks).
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and database systems (SQL/NoSQL).
Experience with Git, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Basic knowledge of AI/ML concepts, LLM integration, and API-based AI tools is a plus.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for building innovative, user-centric products.
Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced startup environment.
No formal degree required—skills, projects, and passion matter most.

Address: C 210 P, Phase 8B, Industrial Area, Sector 74, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160055
Type: Full-time

Job Overview:

We are seeking a highly skilled Sr. Website UI/UX Designer and Developer with expertise in creating, customizing, and maintaining websites on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi. The ideal candidate will have strong design skills and technical proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and Liquid (used in both Shopify and Kajabi). This role involves working on both front-end design and back-end development, including custom themes, plugins, and integrations, with a focus on optimizing e-commerce functionality and course-based platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

Website Design and Customization:
Design and customize websites on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi with a focus on UI/UX and responsive design.
Implement designs based on wireframes, mockups, or from scratch using custom themes and templates for all three platforms.
Theme Customization (WordPress, Shopify, Kajabi):
Develop and modify WordPress themes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.
Customize Shopify themes and Kajabi websites using Liquid for advanced modifications and features.
Leverage Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) to create custom fields and flexible content layouts in WordPress.
Back-End Development:
Write custom PHP for WordPress to develop custom functionality, integrations, and plugin development.
Customize Shopify and Kajabi themes using Liquid to extend functionality and build custom features.
Develop and customize WooCommerce stores and Kajabi sales funnels and course platforms.
API Integration and Custom Functionality:
Integrate third-party services and tools using REST API on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi.
Customize e-commerce features in Shopify and Kajabi, including payment gateways, shipping methods, and marketing tools.
E-commerce Development (Shopify, WooCommerce, Kajabi):
Build and manage e-commerce functionality for Shopify and WooCommerce stores, ensuring seamless customer experiences.
Set up and customize Kajabi sites for course creators and coaches, optimizing sales funnels, membership portals, and user experiences.
Website Optimization:
Ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, and performance, across all platforms.
Implement caching, image optimization, and code efficiency improvements to enhance performance.
Version Control & Collaboration:
Use Git for version control and collaborative development across all projects.
Manage deployments and updates across WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi websites.
Key Requirements:

Front-End Expertise:
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
Experience with JavaScript frameworks or libraries like jQuery for dynamic features.
WordPress Development:
Advanced experience in WordPress theme and plugin development using PHP.
Extensive experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) for custom content management in WordPress.
Shopify Development:
Expertise in Shopify theme customization and building custom features using Liquid.
Familiarity with Shopify APIs for integrating third-party apps and services.
Kajabi Development:
Strong experience working with Kajabi for designing and customizing membership, course, and sales funnel pages.
Ability to use Liquid for advanced customizations in Kajabi to enhance functionality and design.
E-commerce Expertise:
Proficiency in setting up and customizing e-commerce stores on Shopify and WooCommerce.
Experience with Kajabi for building and optimizing online courses, memberships, and sales funnels.
API & REST API Integration:
Experience with API integration across platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Kajabi) for custom functionality.
Performance & SEO Optimization:
Proven track record of optimizing website speed, performance, and SEO best practices across platforms.
Version Control:
Familiarity with Git for version control and collaborative project workflows.

3+ years of experience in WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi development.
Strong portfolio showcasing custom themes, ACF implementations, and e-commerce stores.
Familiarity with WooCommerce, Shopify apps, Kajabi pipelines, and third-party API integrations.

At Warpfy, you’ll work in a high-speed, entrepreneurial environment where ownership and creativity matter more than titles.

Build simple but powerful tools and agents that automate workflows and business processes
Experiment with prompt engineering and AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) to convert concepts into working products
Develop lightweight backends and integrations with third-party platforms (Slack, Google Sheets, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, etc.)

Work on cutting-edge AI + eCommerce automation projects

As a Full Stack Engineer at Prime Corporate, you will play a critical role in building and optimizing our AI-powered Edtech platforms and multi-agent system interfaces. You will work across the technology stack—from backend logic and APIs to intuitive, high-performance frontends—ensuring seamless integration of intelligent agents into our products. This is a high-impact role for a driven engineer who thrives in fast-paced, innovation-led environments and is eager to work on next-generation AI systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.
Build APIs and backend services to support intelligent agent workflows and Edtech functionalities.
Collaborate with AI researchers, product managers, and UI/UX designers to deliver intuitive user experiences.
Implement real-time data visualization, reporting dashboards, and interactive interfaces.
Integrate third-party services, APIs, and AI/ML models into platform features.
Optimize application performance, security, and scalability.
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and deployment.
Document technical designs, architecture decisions, and development processes.
Stay updated with emerging tools, frameworks, and AI-powered development trends.
What We Are Looking For
Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js (or similar frontend frameworks), and Node.js (or similar backend frameworks).
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and database systems (SQL/NoSQL).

Write custom PHP for WordPress to develop custom functionality, integrations, and plugin development.
Customize Shopify and Kajabi themes using Liquid to extend functionality and build custom features.
Develop and customize WooCommerce stores and Kajabi sales funnels and course platforms.
API Integration and Custom Functionality:
Integrate third-party services and tools using REST API on WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi.
Customize e-commerce features in Shopify and Kajabi, including payment gateways, shipping methods, and marketing tools.

Build and manage e-commerce functionality for Shopify and WooCommerce stores, ensuring seamless customer experiences.
Set up and customize Kajabi sites for course creators and coaches, optimizing sales funnels, membership portals, and user experiences.
Website Optimization:
Ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, and performance, across all platforms.

Version Control & Collaboration:
Use Git for version control and collaborative development across all projects.
Manage deployments and updates across WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi websites.

Front-End Expertise:
Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design principles.
Experience with JavaScript frameworks or libraries like jQuery for dynamic features.
WordPress Development:
Advanced experience in WordPress theme and plugin development using PHP.
Extensive experience with Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) for custom content management in WordPress.
Shopify Development:
Expertise in Shopify theme customization and building custom features using Liquid.
Familiarity with Shopify APIs for integrating third-party apps and services.
Kajabi Development:
Strong experience working with Kajabi for designing and customizing membership, course, and sales funnel pages.
Ability to use Liquid for advanced customizations in Kajabi to enhance functionality and design.
E-commerce Expertise:
Proficiency in setting up and customizing e-commerce stores on Shopify and WooCommerce.
Experience with Kajabi for building and optimizing online courses, memberships, and sales funnels.
API & REST API Integration:
Experience with API integration across platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Kajabi) for custom functionality.
Performance & SEO Optimization:
Proven track record of optimizing website speed, performance, and SEO best practices across platforms.
Version Control:
Familiarity with Git for version control and collaborative project workflows.
Preferred Qualifications:

3+ years of experience in WordPress, Shopify, and Kajabi development.
Strong portfolio showcasing custom themes, ACF implementations, and e-commerce stores.
Familiarity with WooCommerce, Shopify apps, Kajabi pipelines, and third-party API integrations.

We are a fast-growing cross-border eCommerce brand, taking Indian products to the world (US, Australia, Canada). Our team includes ex-McKinsey, Amazon, Wayfair, and ex-founders, united by a mission to make Made in India global. At Warpfy, you’ll work in a high-speed, entrepreneurial environment where ownership and creativity matter more than titles.

What You’ll Do

Build simple but powerful tools and agents that automate workflows and business processes
Experiment with prompt engineering and AI APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain) to convert concepts into working products
Develop lightweight backends and integrations with third-party platforms (Slack, Google Sheets, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, etc.)
Work closely with business and operations teams to turn automation ideas into live tools
Rapidly prototype, test, and improve solutions with feedback loops
Document processes and build re-usable code snippets for scaling future tools
What We’re Looking For

Fresh graduate or final-year student in CS/Engineering OR self-taught builder with projects to show
Comfortable coding in Python/JS (bonus if you’ve tinkered with Flask/FastAPI, Node, or similar)
Curiosity for AI/LLMs, APIs, and prompt engineering
Hacker mindset – you enjoy figuring things out, shipping fast, and improving along the way
Basic understanding of databases (SQL/NoSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
Strong problem-solving, willingness to learn, and ability to work independently
Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge AI + eCommerce automation projects
Exposure to global business operations (US, AU, CA markets)
Flat team, direct collaboration with founders
